description: Angular component for map settings in a widget configuration, including form controls, validation, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: MapSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring map widget settings, managing form state, validation, and interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls, subscriptions, and component state.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, especially 'trip' mode.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts validators based on map type.

methods.name: mapTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to map type, initializing image source if needed.

methods.name: updateDragButtonModeSettings
methods.description: Enables or disables drag mode button based on data layer settings.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: editKey
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit data key configuration.

methods.name: generateDataKey
methods.description: Generates a new data key using callbacks.
